rules.title: Theme tokens, not raw values
rules.description: Source uses balsa-* / --balsa-* rather than hex colors or hardcoded px spacing.

rules.title: Identity attribute
rules.description: Renders data-balsa=<item-name> on a host element.

rules.title: Theme resolution
rules.description: Appearance resolves through the target's documented theme path.
